2608.11905.title: Policy-as-logic for robust reasoning over rules
2608.11905.paper_summary: In many practical applications of generative AI systems, from tax rules to airline baggage allowance, responses to natural language queries must respect written policies or rules. We present a hybrid symbolic approach that expresses policies in formal logic and at inference time exploits the representation power of language models for fact extraction to ground predicates, and an answer set solver for reasoning such that responses are interpretable, auditable, and as we show, accurate and robust under input perturbations. Specifically, we show this separation of extraction and reasoning steps outperforms policy-as-prompt and policy-as-code methods in most cases with ~10x reduction in token usage. The results point to the value of structured reasoning and symbolic solvers in conjunction with generative models to make robust decisions involving objective criteria.
2608.11905.paper_summary_zh: 在許多生成式 AI 系統的實際應用中，從稅務規則到航空公司行李配額，對自然語言查詢的回應必須遵循書面政策或規則。<lb/>我們提出了一種混合符號方法，該方法以形式邏輯表達政策，並在推理時利用語言模型的表示能力進行事實提取，以支持謂詞，並使用答案集求解器進行推理，使得回應可解釋、可審計，並且如我們所示，在輸入擾動下準確且穩健。<lb/>具體而言，我們展示了提取和推理步驟的分離在大多數情況下超越了政策作為提示和政策作為代碼的方法，並實現了約 10 倍的標記使用減少。<lb/>結果顯示，結構化推理和符號求解器與生成模型結合的價值，以便在涉及客觀標準的情況下做出穩健的決策。
